[ce] ODE Solver.vi

Owning Palette: Differential Equations

This VI solves ordinary differential equations:
    dX(t)/dt = F(X,t) ,  X(0) = X0
In addition, the VI allows specifying additional parameters and evaluating them in formula.
To determine the solution you can use either Runge-Kutta or Euler method. The Runge Kutta method is more accurate, the Euler method is faster.

Click the parameters for more information

 

method (R-K). Defines a method of solving:
 0 - Runge Kutta
 1 - Euler

0Runge Kutta
1Euler
h (step rate). The Runge Kutta method works with fixed step rates.
time start. Start point of the ordinary differential equation.
time end. End point of the ordinary differential equation.
equation descriptions. A 1D array of clusters describing differential equation.

Clusters consist of string representing right side of the differential equation, name of variable in the left side (the unknown) and its initial value.
variable. Name of variable in the left side of the differential equation (the unknown)
formula. String representing the right side of the differential equation.
init value. Start condition (initial value of variable)
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
time. String denoting the time variable (usually t).
parameters. Array of clusters describing optional parameters that may be used in formula. Cluster consist of parameter name and value.
name parameter name
value parameter value
Times. A 1D array representing the time steps.
X Values (solution). A 2D array of the calculated solutions of the ordinary differential equation at Times.
ticks. Time in milliseconds to produce the results.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
